WITH TEMP1 AS (
SELECT E.GUBUN1 , FORMAT(SUM(A.IWEIGHT),'#,#') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(A.IWEIGHT) -SUM(F.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS DIFFWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(F.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS LANDEDWEIGHT , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A.MIDANGA), 1, 0),'#,#.#') AS STDDUNITPRICE , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A.DANGA), 1, 0),'#,#.#') AS PAYEDUNITPRICE , FORMAT(SUM(A.IKONGKEP),'#,#') AS TOTALPRICE , FORMAT(SUM(A.HALIN),'#,#') AS HALIN FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN IPCHULGO B ON B.J_ID = A.J_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON C.J_SERIAL = A.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD D ON D.DEALER_CD = A.J_ID1 LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE E ON E.GUBUN1 = C.GUBUN1 LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING F ON F.IPCHULGO_MAIPID = A.J_ID WHERE A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A.KERATYPE = '매입' AND F.KERATYPE != '직송' AND F.J_CHECK = '1' AND A.DANGA != 0
AND E.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A.J_SERIAL, E.GUBUN1
SELECT E.GUBUN1 , FORMAT(SUM(A.OWEIGHT),'#,#') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(A.OWEIGHT) - SUM(F.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS DIFFWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(F.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS LANDEDWEIGHT , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A.MIDANGA),1,0),'#,#.#') AS STTDUNITPRICE , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A.DANGA),1,0),'#,#.#') AS SALEUNITPRICE , FORMAT(SUM(A.KONGKEP),'#,#') AS TOTALPRICE , FORMAT(SUM(A.HALIN),'#,#') AS HALIN FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON C.J_SERIAL = A.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD D ON D.DEALER_CD = A.J_ID1 LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE E ON E.GUBUN1 = C.GUBUN1 LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING F ON F.IPCHULGO_MACHULID = A.J_ID WHERE A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A.KERATYPE = '매출' AND F.KERATYPE != '직송' AND F.J_CHECK = '1' AND A.DANGA != 0
AND E.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A.J_SERIAL, E.GUBUN1
SELECT A1.J_SERIAL , B1.GUBUN1 , FORMAT(SUM(A1.OWEIGHT),'#,#') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(A2.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS LANDEDWEIGHT , FORMAT(SUM(A1.OWEIGHT) -SUM(A2.WEIGHT),'#,#') AS DIFFWEIGHT , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A1.MIDANGA), 1, 1),'#,#.#') AS STTDUNITPRICE , FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1),'#,#.#') AS SALEUNITPRICE , FORMAT(SUM(A1.KONGKEP),'#,#') AS TOTALPRICE , FORMAT(MAX(A3.HALIN),'#,#') AS HALIN FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2 ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID LEFT JOIN(SELECT A1.J_SERIAL , B1.GUBUN1 , SUM(A1.HALIN) AS HALIN FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2 ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A1.KERATYPE = '매입' AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송' GROUP BY A1.J_SERIAL, B1.GUBUN1 )A3 ON A1.J_SERIAL = A3.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A1.KERATYPE = '매출' AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송'
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A1.J_SERIAL, B1.GUBUN1
)
SELECT * , (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM TEMP1) AS CNT FROM TEMP1 ORDER BY GUBUN1 ASC OFFSET (#{pageNum}-1)*#{pageLength} ROW FETCH NEXT #{pageLength} ROW ONLY

WITH TEMP1 AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY REPLACE(DEALER_NM, '(주)', '')) AS ROWNUM , ISNULL(C1.DEALER_NM,'') AS DEALER_NM , ISNULL(C2.EMP_NM,'') AS CHRG_NM , FORMAT(SUM(A1.DANJUNG),'#,#') AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT
, FORMAT(SUM(A1.IKONGKEP),'#,#') AS PRICE
, FORMAT(SUM(A1.KONGKEP),'#,#') AS PRICE
, FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1),'#,#.#') AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE , ISNULL(C1.J_REGION,'') AS J_REGION FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID
LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C1 ON A1.J_ID1 = C1.DEALER_CD LEFT JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS C2 ON C1.CHRG_ID = C2.EMP_ID WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송' AND A1.KERATYPE = #{JKGUB} AND A2.J_CHECK = '1' AND A1.DANGA != 0
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY C1.DEALER_NM, C2.EMP_NM, C1.J_REGION
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY REPLACE(DEALER_NM, '(주)', '')) AS ROWNUM , ISNULL(C1.DEALER_NM,'') AS DEALER_NM , ISNULL(C2.EMP_NM,'') AS CHRG_NM , FORMAT(SUM(A1.DANJUNG),'#,#') AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT
, FORMAT(SUM(A1.IKONGKEP),'#,#') AS PRICE
, FORMAT(SUM(A1.KONGKEP),'#,#') AS PRICE
, FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1),'#,#.#') AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE , ISNULL(C1.J_REGION,'') AS J_REGION FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID
LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C1 ON A1.J_ID1 = C1.DEALER_CD LEFT JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS C2 ON C1.CHRG_ID = C2.EMP_ID WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A2.KERATYPE != '직송' AND A1.KERATYPE = #{KERATYPE} AND A2.J_CHECK = '1' AND A1.DANGA != 0
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY C1.DEALER_NM, C2.EMP_NM, C1.J_REGION
)
SELECT * , (SELECT COUNT(0) FROM TEMP1) AS CNT FROM TEMP1 ORDER BY ROWNUM ASC OFFSET (#{pageNum}-1)*#{pageLength} ROW FETCH NEXT #{pageLength} ROW ONLY

WITH TEMP1 AS (
SELECT ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.ACCEPTWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT --인수량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.DIFFWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS DIFFWEIGHT --차이중량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.LANDEDWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS LANDEDWEIGHT --대지중량 , ISNULL(FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(Z1.PAYEDUNITPRICE), 1, 0),'#,#.#'),'') AS PAYEDUNITPRICE --지급단가 , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.TOTALPRICE),'#,#'),'') AS TOTALPRICE --금액 , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.HALIN),'#,#'),'') AS HALIN --감량 FROM ( SELECT SUM(A.IWEIGHT) AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , SUM(A.IWEIGHT) -SUM(F.WEIGHT) AS DIFFWEIGHT , SUM(F.WEIGHT) AS LANDEDWEIGHT , ROUND(AVG(A.DANGA), 1, 0) AS PAYEDUNITPRICE , SUM(A.IKONGKEP) AS TOTALPRICE , SUM(A.HALIN) AS HALIN FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON C.J_SERIAL = A.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE E ON E.GUBUN1 = C.GUBUN1 LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING F ON F.IPCHULGO_MAIPID = A.J_ID WHERE A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A.KERATYPE = '매입' AND F.KERATYPE != '직송' AND F.J_CHECK = '1' AND A.DANGA != 0
AND E.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A.J_SERIAL, E.GUBUN1 ) Z1
SELECT ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.ACCEPTWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.DIFFWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS DIFFWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.LANDEDWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS LANDEDWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(Z1.SALEUNITPRICE),1,0),'#,#.#'),'') AS SALEUNITPRICE , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.TOTALPRICE),'#,#'),'') AS TOTALPRICE , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.HALIN),'#,#'),'') AS HALIN FROM ( SELECT SUM(A.OWEIGHT) AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , SUM(A.OWEIGHT) - SUM(F.WEIGHT) AS DIFFWEIGHT , SUM(F.WEIGHT) AS LANDEDWEIGHT , ROUND(AVG(A.DANGA),1,0) AS SALEUNITPRICE , SUM(A.KONGKEP) AS TOTALPRICE , SUM(A.HALIN) AS HALIN FROM INLIST A LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE C ON C.J_SERIAL = A.J_SERIAL LEFT OUTER JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD D ON D.DEALER_CD = A.J_ID1 LEFT OUTER JOIN JAJAE E ON E.GUBUN1 = C.GUBUN1 LEFT OUTER JOIN MESURING F ON F.IPCHULGO_MACHULID = A.J_ID WHERE A.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A.KERATYPE = '매출' AND F.KERATYPE != '직송' AND F.J_CHECK = '1' AND A.DANGA != 0
AND E.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A.J_SERIAL, E.GUBUN1)Z1
SELECT ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.ACCEPTWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.LANDEDWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS LANDEDWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.DIFFWEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS DIFFWEIGHT , ISNULL(FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(Z1.SALEUNITPRICE), 1, 1),'#,#.#'),'') AS SALEUNITPRICE , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.TOTALPRICE),'#,#'),'') AS TOTALPRICE , ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.HALIN),'#,#'),'') AS HALIN FROM ( SELECT SUM(A1.OWEIGHT) AS ACCEPTWEIGHT , SUM(A2.WEIGHT) AS LANDEDWEIGHT , SUM(A1.OWEIGHT) -SUM(A2.WEIGHT) AS DIFFWEIGHT , ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1) AS SALEUNITPRICE , SUM(A1.KONGKEP) AS TOTALPRICE , MAX(A3.HALIN) AS HALIN FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2 ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID LEFT JOIN(SELECT A1.J_SERIAL , B1.GUBUN1 , SUM(A1.HALIN) AS HALIN FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2 ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A1.KERATYPE = '매입' AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송' GROUP BY A1.J_SERIAL, B1.GUBUN1 )A3 ON A1.J_SERIAL = A3.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A1.KERATYPE = '매출' AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송'
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY A1.J_SERIAL, B1.GUBUN1 )Z1
)
SELECT 'TOT' AS TYPE , * FROM TEMP1

WITH TEMP1 AS (
SELECT ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.ACCEPT_WEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT --인수량
, ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.PRICE),'#,#'),'') AS PRICE --금액
, ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.PRICE),'#,#'),'') AS PRICE
, ISNULL(FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(Z1.AVG_UNIT_PRICE), 0),'#,#.#'),'') AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE --평균단가 FROM ( SELECT SUM(A1.DANJUNG) AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT
, SUM(A1.IKONGKEP) AS PRICE
, SUM(A1.KONGKEP) AS PRICE
, ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1) AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID
LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C1 ON A1.J_ID1 = C1.DEALER_CD LEFT JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS C2 ON C1.CHRG_ID = C2.EMP_ID WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A2.KERATYPE = '직송' AND A1.KERATYPE = #{JKGUB} AND A2.J_CHECK = '1' AND A1.DANGA != 0
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY C1.DEALER_NM, C2.EMP_NM )Z1
SELECT ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.ACCEPT_WEIGHT),'#,#'),'') AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT
, ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.PRICE),'#,#'),'') AS PRICE
, ISNULL(FORMAT(SUM(Z1.PRICE),'#,#'),'') AS PRICE
, ISNULL(FORMAT(ROUND(AVG(Z1.AVG_UNIT_PRICE), 0),'#,#'),'') AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE FROM ( SELECT SUM(A1.DANJUNG) AS ACCEPT_WEIGHT
, SUM(A1.IKONGKEP) AS PRICE
, SUM(A1.KONGKEP) AS PRICE
, ROUND(AVG(A1.DANGA), 1, 1) AS AVG_UNIT_PRICE FROM INLIST A1 LEFT JOIN MESURING A2
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MAIPID
ON A1.J_ID = A2.IPCHULGO_MACHULID
LEFT JOIN JAJAE B1 ON A1.J_SERIAL = B1.J_SERIAL LEFT JOIN ACC_DEALER_CD C1 ON A1.J_ID1 = C1.DEALER_CD LEFT JOIN HR_EMP_BASIS C2 ON C1.CHRG_ID = C2.EMP_ID WHERE A1.J_DATE BETWEEN #{FDATE} AND #{TDATE} AND A2.KERATYPE != '직송' AND A1.KERATYPE = #{KERATYPE} AND A2.J_CHECK = '1' AND A1.DANGA != 0
AND B1.DAEGUBUN IN
#{item}
GROUP BY C1.DEALER_NM, C2.EMP_NM )Z1
)
SELECT 'TOT' AS TYPE , * FROM TEMP1
